plans.buy_case: IONQ is firing classic mean-reversion signals—RSI at 39.9 (oversold), price touching lower Bollinger Band, and elevated volume suggest institutional accumulation into a technical bottom. The golden cross and price sitting right at the 200MA provide confirmation that the downtrend may be reversing, though the lack of recent catalysts means you're betting on technical recovery, not fundamentals.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on a touch of the lower Bollinger Band (≈$47.50) with RSI confirmation staying 20–40 range, OR buy 50% now at $49.31 and scale remaining 50% if price pulls back to $48.00. Avoid FOMO buying into any gap-up open without a pullback.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit at 50MA resistance ($54.51) or if RSI closes above 70 on strong volume. Hard stop: break below lower BB on high volume (suggests false reversal) or RSI drops back to 25 (failed bottom).
plans.risk: IONQ is speculative; quantum computing adoption is years away. Without recent news, this is pure technicals—a surprise earnings miss or sector rotation could gap down hard. At $49, you're also fighting the fact that price is already *at* the 200MA, leaving limited margin of safety. Position sizing ($148) is prudent but monitor opportunity cost vs. higher-conviction setups.

Before entering, spend 10 minutes checking: (1) recent earnings beat/miss, (2) any analyst downgrades in last month, (3) sector rotation out of semis. If all clear, enter on the dip. If macro feels shaky (bonds selling off, growth fears rising), skip it—there will be other setups.

plans.buy_case: STLD is showing textbook mean-reversion setup: price compressed near lower Bollinger Band with BB squeeze active, MACD histogram bottoming, and healthy technicals (golden cross, price above 200MA, above-average volume). Steel cyclicals have predictable swing patterns, and the risk/reward is attractive if fundamentals remain solid. However, the missing current news data is a material gap—recent earnings misses or negative guidance could invalidate this setup.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for one of two triggers: (1) RSI drops into your 20-30 buy zone (currently 44.4 is too neutral), OR (2) price touches the lower Bollinger Band (~$240). Do NOT chase at current levels. If RSI stays 40-50, this loses edge.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at RSI 65+ or price hits upper BB (~$258); cut loss if price breaks below lower BB on heavy volume or if negative earnings/guidance drops post-entry.
plans.timeframe: 3-4 weeks (typical swing for steel cyclicals in consolidation patterns)
plans.risk: Steel is cyclical and macro-sensitive. Deteriorating economic data, China slowdown, or weak Q3 earnings could gap through your stop. You're also entering into a BB squeeze—low volatility now means a big move is coming, but direction is uncertain without fundamental clarity.
plans.recommendation: **PASS for now.** The technicals are clean, but the missing news data is disqualifying for a busy student trader. Steel earnings cycles matter more than most sectors. Before risking $3K+, spend 15 minutes confirming: (1) latest earnings beat/miss, (2) forward guidance intact, (3) no major capex/dividend cuts. If all three are solid, revisit when RSI hits 25-30—that's your real buy zone. Right now you're betting on mean reversion without the fundamental floor. Too risky for your profile.

Either: (1) wait for a deeper dip to $1,285 to improve your entry margin of safety, or (2) look for a similar mean-reversion setup in a lower-priced quality tech stock where you can size meaningfully.
